mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals monetary easing, compressing discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained inflationary pressure (CPIAUCSL crossing above 3.0%) triggers a negative S&P 500 forward return over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate higher interest rates.
failure_condition: 20d returns not negative when CPIAUCSL crosses above 3.0%, or p-value > 0.05 in t-test.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both quarterly demand (GDPC1) and unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals robust economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and UNRATE both rise simultaneously
failure_condition: 20d returns not significantly positive when both proxies rise, or p-value > 0.05 in t-test.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, a sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) accelerates equity valuation growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d returns not positive when FEDFUNDS declines in late-cycle expansion, or p-value > 0.05 in t-test over 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in monthly labor participation (PAYEMS) reflects strengthening job markets, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns not significantly positive when PAYEMS rises, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained contraction in industrial production (INDPRO) below 90.0 triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as reduced output signals economic slowdown.
failure_condition: 20d returns not negative when INDPRO drops below 90, or p-value > 0.05 in t-test.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and CPIAUCSL inflation triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate higher interest rates and inflation.
candidate_trigger: both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL rise simultaneously
failure_condition: 20d returns not negative when both proxies rise, or p-value > 0.05 in t-test over 1-month window.

mechanism_narrative: During a recessionary environment, a sustained rise in quarterly demand (GDPC1) signals economic recovery, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d returns not positive when GDPC1 rises in recession, or p-value > 0.05 in t-test over 6-month window.
